name: Copper methanesulfonate
description: Copper methanesulfonate (CAS 54253-62-2 ) is a copper salt of methanesulfonic acid used primarily as an electrolyte source in copper electroplating and electrodeposition processes. Its high solubility and low corrosivity compared to sulfate-based alternatives make it a preferred choice for precision metal finishing operations. In electronics manufacturing, it functions as the copper ion source in plating baths for printed circuit boards, semiconductor interconnects, and wafer-level packaging, where deposit uniformity and bath stability are critical. Copper methanesulfonate electrolytes are also applied in decorative and functional plating across automotive and industrial components, delivering smooth, adherent copper layers for various applications. In mining and hydrometallurgy, it appears in electrowinning and electrorefining circuits where methanesulfonate-based systems offer improved current efficiency and better performance in demanding environments. Catalytic applications include its use as a Lewis acid catalyst in select organic synthesis processes relevant to specialty chemical production, providing high reactivity and selectivity in chemical reactions. Copper methanesulfonate is supplied as an aqueous solution, with concentration typically expressed as copper content or as percent active salt. Technical and electronic grades are available for industrial use. Electronic-grade material is held to tighter limits on metallic impurities to meet semiconductor fabrication requirements.
